title: Triage and label unlabeled items
body:
This task involved identifying and labeling all open issues and pull requests in the beercss/beercss repository that were missing labels.

Using the GitHub REST API and the provided JULES_GITHUB_TOKEN:
1. Scanned for unlabeled open items.
2. Found PR #609 "chore: bump dependencies to latest stable versions".
3. Analyzed title and body for keywords.
4. Applied the 'enhancement' label to PR #609.
5. Verified that all open issues and PRs now have at least one label.

No code changes were made to the repository as the actions were performed directly via the GitHub API.
